lemmas.statement: If r1+r2+r3 = 1 over Q then sum (ri - 1/3)^2 = sum ri^2 - 1/3, so h=(1/3,1/3,1/3) is the unique l2 minimizer among residuals with I=1, with squared norm 1/3.

near_misses.claim: Existing theorems every_primal_competitor_at_least_three and dual_unit_pairs_every_residual_to_three restate E18 with bound 3 for the l1 norm.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: E18 has I(x)=1 and the l1 bound is 1, not 3; the cited fixture is a different example.

near_misses.claim: Adjoining a 2-face supplies a potential and removes the obstruction for E18.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Adjoining a 2-face changes the complex, and I=1 persists for every residual of the unfilled triangle.

open_obligations: The definition of d0 and the sign convention in the source file are not shown, so g=(0,2/3,1/3) giving x-h=d0 g is unchecked.
No existing Lean declaration matches E18 (I=1, x=(1,0,0)); the cited fixture has bound 3.
The l1 tie (1/2,1/2,0) and the dual certificate y=(1,1,1) are not Lean-grounded for E18.
The signature of pairing is not shown, so it is not used as a generator.
The uniqueness proof of the l2 minimizer is not written.
The lemma l_l2_shift has no sorry-free proof.
